# omni-render

> Our own web rendering engine in Rust: packed DOM, own CSS engine, integer layout, 2-bit raster, a program runtime that emits x86, a JavaScript interpreter on its own IR, and a self-repair core for layout.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render && cd omni-render && cargo test --release` (expect: test result: ok).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (renderer); doctor and T25 core PolyForm Small Business OR Noncommercial.
